Brand Guidelines

Clinical Skin Recovery · Est. 2026

01 · Logo System

Two lockups, one brand

The stacked crest leads on products and packaging; the horizontal lockup leads on the website, letterheads, and documents. Never redraw, re-color, or re-typeset either mark.

Primary — Products & Packaging

Stacked Crest

Regeneration Burst crest above the wordmark: copper derma, cobalt Sozo script. On packaging the crest renders in embossed copper foil, all bronze. Use on labels, cartons, and social avatars.

Primary — Web & Letterhead

Horizontal Lockup

Crest at left of the wordmark for headers, email signatures, letterheads, and any wide format.

Reversed — Dark Grounds

Reversed Stacked

For navy or teal backgrounds. Maintain contrast; never place the standard mark on dark grounds.

Rules

Usage

✓Clearspace = height of the burst crest on all sides
✓Minimum size: 32 px crest height (stacked), 140 px width (horizontal)
✕No stretching, recoloring, drop shadows, or outlines
✕No taglines or icons locked to the mark
✕“SoZo” casing is sacred — never “Sozo” or “SOZO” in text
02 · Color

Palette

Clinical calm with a warm metallic accent. Teal leads authority; cobalt carries depth; copper brings the premium foil warmth.

Deep Teal#0B6E6E · Primary / authority
Navy Ink#1B2F66 · Headlines / wordmark text
Copper#B87551 · Accent / burst core / CTAs
Copper Light#E1BFA5 · Foil highlights / accents
Sky Blue#CAEFFF · Highlights / cool accents
03 · Typography

Type system

Display — DM Serif Display
Recover Beautifully.
Body — Karla (400 / 500 / 700)
DermaSoZo is the first clinical-grade recovery system that heals damaged skin in two simple steps, trusted by physicians, loved by skin.
Detail — Karla Bold, tracked caps
TOPICAL ANALGESIC · CLINICAL RECOVERY

The “Sozo” script in the logo is custom-outlined artwork — never simulate it with a live font.

04 · Packaging

Recovery Mist™ label

Satin cobalt ground with the embossed copper-foil crest (all-bronze burst, foil derma, white Sozo), Recovery Mist™ in white DM Serif, and SKIN RECOVERY SYSTEM in tracked copper caps over a copper rule. QR and UPC print as bare white codes, no plates. Drug Facts panel follows FDA OTC format on white.

05 · Packaging

OPC DermMist™ label

The teal sister to Recovery Mist™. Same satin cobalt ground, crest and accents render in embossed deep-teal foil, OPC DermMist™ in white DM Serif, SKIN RECOVERY SYSTEM in tracked teal caps over a teal rule. Back panel carries the cosmetic ingredient declaration with bare white QR and UPC codes, centered as one cluster.

06 · In the World

Product photography

Frosted cobalt bottles on marble spa or white studio surfaces, soft daylight. Recovery Mist™ wears the copper spray top and copper foil crest; OPC DermMist™ wears a white spray top and deep-teal foil. Shot together, the copper and white caps read as the two-step system at a glance.

07 · Voice

How DermaSoZo speaks

The customer is the hero

StoryBrand framing: she wants her skin back. DermaSoZo is the calm, clinical guide with a proven 2-step system. We never make the brand the hero.

CAFE cadence

Captivate with the moment of damage, agitate the cost of waiting, fascinate with the recovery story, educate with the clinical why.

Tone

Warm authority. Short sentences. Evidence over hype. “Recover Beautifully.” is the promise — clinical results, beautifully delivered.

Vocabulary

Say: recovery, clinical-grade, protocol, barrier. Avoid: miracle, cure, anti-aging clichés, fear-based burn language on-pack.
